hardware.name: Hardware & Diagnostics
hardware.description: Tools for monitoring, benchmarking, and diagnosing hardware components including CPU, memory, storage, and system sensors.

privacy.name: Privacy & Optimization
privacy.description: Utilities to enhance system privacy, disable telemetry, remove bloatware, and optimize Windows performance.

sysinternals.name: Microsoft Sysinternals
sysinternals.description: Advanced system utilities from Microsoft for troubleshooting, monitoring processes, and analyzing system behavior.

utilities.name: System Utilities
utilities.description: Essential system tools for file search, registry editing, activation, and general Windows management.

packages.name: Package Managers
packages.description: Graphical interfaces for managing software installations across multiple package managers.

tools.name: bleachbit
tools.description: Clean application caches, temporary files, and browsing traces.
features: Choose which applications and data types to clean.
Preview selected cleanup operations before deleting files.
Remove temporary files and application caches.
Runs from the official portable ZIP without installation.

tools.name: blockrazer
tools.description: Disables automatic launch of Razer Synapse software and related services on Windows, minimizing background resource usage.
features: Disables startup entries for Razer Synapse
Stops and disables Razer services running in the background
Reversible - can re-enable services if needed

tools.name: cleanmgr
tools.description: Enhanced disk cleanup utility that replaces Windows' built-in tool with additional cleanup options and a modern interface.
features: All cleanup options from original Disk Cleanup plus customizations
Removes temporary files, system cache, Windows Update remnants
Advanced cleanup for system areas not accessible in default tool
Modern user-friendly interface with checkboxes
Automation options for scheduled cleanups

tools.name: cpuz
tools.description: Lightweight system profiling tool that provides detailed information on CPU, motherboard, memory, and hardware components.
features: Detailed CPU information: architecture, clock speed, cache levels
Motherboard specifications: model, chipset, BIOS version
Memory module details: type, size, speed
Real-time monitoring of CPU core frequencies and voltage
Portable and easy to use

tools.name: diskinfo
tools.description: Disk health monitoring tool that provides detailed drive information including temperature, health status, and S.M.A.R.T. attributes.
features: Monitors health status, temperature, and S.M.A.R.T. info for HDDs/SSDs
Real-time alerts for potential drive issues
Power-on hours, reallocated sector count, and other metrics
Customizable alert thresholds for specific attributes
Portable and easy to use

tools.name: diskmark
tools.description: Disk benchmarking tool that measures read and write speeds of storage devices with detailed performance metrics.
features: Sequential and random read/write tests
Multiple test sizes and configurations
Detailed metrics: MB/s and IOPS
Customizable test parameters (queue depth, duration)
Portable and thorough performance testing

tools.name: everything
tools.description: Fast and efficient search utility for Windows that instantly locates files and folders with minimal resource usage.
features: Instant file indexing with real-time results
Search by file name, folder, size, and date modified
Minimal system resource usage
Advanced search operators for complex queries
Bookmarks for frequent searches and export results

tools.name: hwinfo
tools.description: Comprehensive hardware information and diagnostic tool with in-depth system monitoring, sensor data, and reporting.
features: Detailed information on CPU, GPU, memory, storage
Real-time sensor monitoring: temperatures, voltages, fan speeds
Customizable reports for diagnostics and health checks
Alert and notification system based on sensor thresholds
Extensive logging options for performance tracking

tools.name: mas
tools.description: Script suite for activating Windows and Office products with flexible activation options.
features: Multiple activation methods
Support for Windows and Office products
Open-source and community-maintained
Flexible activation options

tools.name: microsoft-autoruns
tools.description: Powerful utility for managing startup items, allowing users to view, manage, and disable programs and services that run automatically.
features: Comprehensive lists of startup items: programs, services, drivers, scheduled tasks
Enable/disable startup entries with one click
Identifies startup item locations across registry and file system
Highlights known malware entry points and Microsoft items
Online search for additional details on startup items

tools.name: microsoft-procexp
tools.description: Advanced task manager utility that provides in-depth insight into active processes and system resource usage.
features: Hierarchical view of all running processes
Detailed process attributes: CPU, memory, I/O usage, threads, handles
Real-time monitoring of resource-intensive processes
Search tool to locate which processes use specific files/DLLs
Process killing and suspension options

tools.name: microsoft-procmon
tools.description: Real-time monitoring tool that captures detailed events related to file system, registry, and process activity.
features: Monitors file system, registry, network, and process events
Powerful filtering options to isolate specific events
Event detail views with process info, timestamps, action results
Save and export captured data for analysis
Stack trace capture for code-level diagnostics

tools.name: microsoft-tcpview
tools.description: Inspect TCP and UDP endpoints and the processes that own them.
features: Display local and remote addresses and ports.
Identify the process associated with each endpoint.
Highlight connection changes as the view refreshes.
Save connection listings for troubleshooting.

tools.name: ooapb
tools.description: Free tool that helps users manage and remove unwanted pre-installed applications and bloatware from Windows 10/11.
features: Lists all pre-installed apps including hidden and protected system apps
Selective removal of unwanted applications and bundled software
Supports reinstallation of previously removed apps
Overview of app usage to help decide what to keep
Undo functionality to restore removed apps

tools.name: ooregedt
tools.description: Advanced Windows registry editor with enhanced features for better registry management and navigation.
features: Search, edit, and navigate registry with improved speed
Address bar for quick navigation to specific registry paths
Bookmarking for frequently accessed registry keys
Export and import feature for backup and sharing
History function to track and revisit recent edits

tools.name: oosu10
tools.description: Privacy-focused utility for Windows that controls and disables telemetry, tracking, and data-sharing features.
features: Granular options to disable Windows telemetry and data collection
Turn off location tracking, feedback requests, activity history
One-click 'Recommended Settings' for quick privacy setup
Easy rollback of changes to restore defaults
Completely portable - no installation required

tools.name: optimizer
tools.description: Versatile tool for optimizing Windows systems with options to disable unnecessary services, remove bloatware, and enhance privacy.
features: Disables telemetry, data collection, background services
Removes pre-installed Windows apps and bloatware
Performance improvements: disables animations, startup delays
Built-in firewall management tool
Portable and open-source

tools.name: rufus
tools.description: Create bootable USB drives from Windows, Linux, and recovery ISO images.
features: Write bootable ISO images to USB drives.
Choose partition scheme and target system.
Format USB media through the graphical interface.
Uses the portable x64 release.

tools.name: supermsconfig
tools.description: Advanced system configuration tool that extends MSConfig functionality with more control over startup and services.
features: In-depth management of startup programs and background services
Disable, enable, or delay startup items to optimize boot time
Manage Windows services with detailed descriptions
Control over scheduled tasks and system settings
Export and import configurations for easy setup

tools.name: unigetui
tools.description: User interface for managing software packages on Windows in a simplified, visual environment.
features: Intuitive UI for browsing and installing software packages
Support for multiple package sources
Manage installed software: update and uninstall packages
Search functionality to quickly locate applications
Graphical interface alternative to command-line operations

tools.name: winutils
tools.description: Comprehensive PowerShell-based tool to optimize, debloat, and customize Windows systems for better performance and security.
features: Automated scripts for system cleanup and bloatware removal
Privacy and security enhancements: disable telemetry, tracking
Optimize system settings: power options, disable visual effects
Bulk uninstallation of pre-installed apps
Advanced network and firewall settings

tools.name: wiztree
tools.description: Visual disk space analyzer for finding large files and folders.
features: Scan disk usage and inspect a visual treemap.
Sort files and folders by size.
Export scan results for later comparison.
Portable x64 version; free for personal use.

tools.name: xdantispy
tools.description: Privacy tool for Windows that disables telemetry and data collection features for enhanced control over personal data.
features: Disables Windows telemetry, diagnostics, data-sharing
Blocks Microsoft's data collection servers
Selective deactivation of Cortana, location tracking, personalized ads
Advanced network and firewall settings
Simple checkbox-based interface
